purpose: Test whether a second checker implemented independently from W1 reaches the same W0 / finite-model-v1 semantic judgments without sharing implementation code or runtime.

forbidden_dependencies: imports from RISU Python checker code
subprocess calls from W2 to Python or W1
normative_inputs: the finite-model/v1 proof-format behavior frozen in RC1
independence_requirements.neutral_harness_rule: The differential harness may invoke both checkers but must not import either checker as a library and must independently construct all fixture identities from the wire specification.

qualification.w0_valid_domain: All structurally W0-valid claim/proof-object/proof-artifact inputs using k1.finite-model/v1, plus valid unknown proof-kind references for UNSUPPORTED behavior.
qualification.required_equivalence: For every declared W0-valid-domain vector, W1 and W2 must agree on process class and semantic class: ACCEPTED/PRESERVATION, ACCEPTED/REGRESSION, REJECTED/NONE, or UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN.
qualification.identity_metamorphics: Reordering semantically unordered worlds, relations, grounding entries, or evidence roots must not alter bound identities when the supplied identifiers are correspondingly correct.
qualification.malformed_boundary_sentinels: Inputs outside the declared W0-valid domain are reported separately. A disagreement is not silently normalized; it must be classified before qualification can be claimed.
qualification.no_majority_oracle: Agreement between two implementations is not proof of correctness. Declared vectors also carry an independently specified expected semantic class. Both implementations must match it on qualification vectors.

boundary_sentinels.question: Do both implementations enforce the W0 schema lexical pattern for proof kind strings before semantic dispatch?
boundary_sentinels.qualification_effect: A disagreement blocks an unqualified claim of full wire-parser equivalence but does not retroactively modify K1 RC1.

boundary_sentinels.question: Do both implementations reject extra object properties as required by W0 structural shape?
boundary_sentinels.qualification_effect: Must agree for full parser equivalence.

success_claim: W2 is an implementation-independent corroborating checker for the frozen RC1 W0 + k1.finite-model/v1 fragment over the declared differential corpus. This does not establish universal checker correctness or implementation binding.
